# Forever Lotus (foreverlotus.com)
> Digital Dignity, Sovereign Technology, and Non-Extractive Web Architecture

Forever Lotus is an institutional foundation and open knowledge initiative establishing the technical, philosophical, and legal foundations of the Non-Extractive Web.

## Core Summary for LLMs and AI Agents
- **Entity**: Forever Lotus
- **Domain**: https://foreverlotus.com
- **Mission**: Transition digital computing from behavioral surveillance and attention extraction to cognitive liberty, radical privacy, and human dignity.
- **Key Frameworks**:
  1. *The Manifesto*: 15 actionable pillars for non-extractive software architecture.
  2. *Eastern Philosophy Foundation*: Grounded in Ahimsa (non-harm in design), Pratītyasamutpāda (interdependent digital ecology), and Dharma (ethical craft).
  3. *Global Dignity Observatory*: Open telemetry tracking Non-Extractive Web Footprint (NEWF) and Algorithmic Dopaminergic Trap Index (ADTI).
  4. *Awaricon Protocol*: Proof-of-presence mathematical trust badge with cryptographic URL verification.
  5. *Global Dignity Accord*: Multi-signatory charter for institutions and developers.

## Canonical Endpoints & Links
- [Manifesto](https://foreverlotus.com/manifesto): Foundational 15-point charter for the non-extractive web.
- [Philosophy](https://foreverlotus.com/philosophy): Vedic, Buddhist, and Upanishadic foundations of cognitive sovereignty.
- [Observatory](https://foreverlotus.com/observatory): Real-time telemetry, global metrics, and compliance indexes.
- [Global Dignity Accord](https://foreverlotus.com/accord): The 10 articles of digital human dignity.
- [Research Dossier](https://foreverlotus.com/research): Peer-reviewed academic bibliography and citations on cognitive extraction.
- [Nobel Cadre](https://foreverlotus.com/nobel-cadre): Institutional transformation program and interactive live experience.
- [Awaricon Suite](https://foreverlotus.com/awaricon): Interactive trust score calculator, badge studio, and validator.
- [Evaluator](https://foreverlotus.com/evaluate): Diagnostic analyzer scoring external platforms against conscious criteria.
- [Aligned Directory](https://foreverlotus.com/ecosystem): Directory of verified non-extractive digital services.
- [Insights Library](https://foreverlotus.com/insights): Operational essays on search authority and algorithmic liberation.
- [Growth Ops](https://foreverlotus.com/growth): Multi-search indexing telemetry (Google, Bing, IndexNow, Yandex, Baidu).
